purpose: Execute the atomic reenumerate-after-topology-change operation within the MA-31 boundary: Root-only topology refresh/enumeration. It does not repair or validate stale references and does not edit component occurrences.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires reenumerate-after-topology-change and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: current_design
inputs.description: Implicit active root design enumerated by the action; no explicit operation parameter is consumed.

preconditions: A readable root part/document context is available.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {bodies: list<DesignBody>, faces: list<face>, edges: list<edge>} freshly enumerated from the root part.

postconditions: The returned lists come from a new current_bodies() enumeration and flatten each body's current Faces and Edges collections.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic reenumerate-after-topology-change operation within the MA-31 boundary: Root-only topology refresh/enumeration. It does not repair or validate stale references and does not edit component occurrences. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: No document selection is performed inside this action; supplied references are validated directly.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Explicitly reacquires root DesignBodies, faces, and edges; callers must discard previous cached references.

failure_modes.condition: Root descendant enumeration or topology access raises.
failure_modes.detection: Root descendant enumeration or topology access raises.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

recovery.action: Stop and diagnose document/runtime state; rerun after the document is stable.
